mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls above 0.3% monthly indicates strengthening labor demand, which boosts corporate earnings and supports higher equity valuations over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in the Housing Starts Index exceeding 10% signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and drags on corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in the Industrial Production Index below -0.5% monthly indicates supply-side weakness, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 0.25% signals a tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in Real Personal Income exceeding 2% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals labor market overheating, which increases wage pressure and reduces profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in Real Personal Income above 0.5% combined with a 3-month decline in Housing Starts exceeding 5% signals divergent demand signals, which increases uncertainty and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > 0.5% AND HOUST falls > 5% for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).
